meta.selection_rule: max nDCG@10; ties within 0.005 -> lowest latency

metrics.labeling_note: TargetHit@k is 1 if any grade-2 gold chunk_id appears in the top-k results. Recall@k counts all grade-2 labels, while nDCG@k uses grades 0-2. Unpooled labels should not be interpreted as corpus-level Recall.
